Task 6 input, not testable on this platform: a column of numpy long doubles. On Linux x86-64 np.longdouble is 80-bit (itemsize 16), and Schema.from_data takes such a column (wire/dtypes.py:231-232 types any float over 4 bytes float64), so this is reachable there; on macOS arm64, where this phase ran, np.longdouble is float64. Arrow has no long double type, so the core cannot be given the column as typed Arrow; whether describe_frames refuses it or narrows it to float64 is a Phase 9 decision.
